description: A clinical research nurse manager must decide whether to enroll an outpatient in a phase II clinical trial and finalize the first treatment visit, investigational product, observation period, and regulatory documentation, with input from the principal investigator, research pharmacist, and regulatory coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The outpatient research unit has one opening for a new participant in the phase II TRX-41 study next Monday.
shared_context.S2: The referred patient has completed the standard referral intake and is waiting for the study team to make a final enrollment decision.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the binding decision about enrollment and the first treatment visit.
shared_context.S4: The unit's routine pre-enrollment huddle includes the principal investigator, research pharmacist, and regulatory coordinator before any participant is scheduled.

PF1.text: Dr. Chen reviewed the patient's pathology and signed the study eligibility note: the patient meets the protocol's disease criterion, and the approved first dose is TRX-41 200 mg IV on study day 1.

PF2.text: Luis's current investigational-product worksheet requires a 90-minute post-infusion observation for the first TRX-41 dose, and the preparation must be performed in the Clinical Research Unit's monitored treatment chair.

PF3.text: Nadia verified that the patient signed the currently approved consent form version 4.2 and confirmed the patient can attend the first treatment visit Monday at 09:00; the consent and appointment details have not yet been entered into the study system.

acceptance_conditions: Enrollment must be approved because the principal investigator confirmed the patient's protocol eligibility.
The first treatment must use TRX-41 at exactly 200 mg IV.
The first dose must include exactly 90 minutes of post-infusion observation.
The first visit must be scheduled for Monday at 09:00 in the Clinical Research Unit.
The current consent form version 4.2 must be recorded.
A commitment must be made to enter the enrollment and consent documentation into the study system.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'study_system_entry' and c['target'] == 'Regulatory' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The signed eligibility note changes enrollment from an unsupported approval to approval, and it fixes the treatment choice from an unspecified study drug and dose to TRX-41 200 mg IV.
The pharmacy worksheet changes the observation plan from an unspecified duration to exactly 90 minutes after the first infusion.
The regulatory verification changes the visit from an unspecified appointment to Monday at 09:00, fixes the recorded consent version at 4.2, and creates the need for a study-system entry commitment.
